title: Checklist of accessible visual storytelling

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Judge imagery by comprehension as well as appearance so viewers can understand the intended message.
strategic_value: Purpose, reading order and alternative text can help Helsinki visual communications serve more residents.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture presents a checklist connecting image purpose, emotional tone, visual literacy, detail, symbols, layout and alternative text.
practical_value: Check whether an image conveys its intended meaning at the actual size and whether explanatory text is needed.

content_islands.name: Accessibility checklist
content_islands.spec: Keep the ten checks together in their reading order, ending with the alternative-text condition.

reference_purposes.Intent: The checklist links choices to understanding, emotional support and avoiding distracting detail.
reference_purposes.Application: It asks designers to check image purpose, reading order, symbols and final size.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Alternative text is required unless the image or graphic is purely decorative.
